title: WhatsApp
description: Connect a WhatsApp Business number through Meta's Cloud API. Its messages open tickets here, and your replies go back to WhatsApp.

connections.title: Numbers
connections.description: Each number speaks through a phone number ID and a system user's access token from Meta.
connections.emptyBody: Connect a WhatsApp Business number to take its messages as tickets in this workspace.
connections.tipChat: A customer's message opens a ticket
connections.tipWindow: Reply within 24 hours, or send a template
connections.tipTemplates: Approve templates at Meta, then sync them here
connections.testedAttention: Meta did not accept these credentials.
connections.subscribed: Meta now sends this number's messages to opendesk.
connections.disconnectBody: {{name}} stops opening tickets here. Its tickets stay.

connect.title: Connect a WhatsApp number
connect.description: Find these in the Meta app of the business that owns the number.
connect.name: Name
connect.nameHint: Shown in settings. The number's verified name when empty.
connect.brandHint: The brand its tickets belong to.
connect.accessTokenHint: A system user's token with the messaging permission.
connect.appSecretHint: The Meta app's secret that signs its webhook calls.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Message templates Meta approved for these numbers. Approve them at Meta, then sync them here.
templates.emptyBody: Templates let you write to a customer outside the 24 hour window. Approve one at Meta, then sync it here.
templates.name: Name
